chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The camel is released in the Sanctuary to eat whatever it desires.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on releasing a camel in the Haram to eat?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the sanctity of Al-Haram by illustrating the freedom of livestock within its boundaries, serving as a practical indicator of the area's protected status. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the concept of 'Ihram' restrictions being lifted for animals, reinforcing the spiritual and legal inviolability of the sacred precincts. It reflects the broader Islamic principle that the sanctity of the Haram extends to all living creatures within its domain.
